name: Prospector Paulina dispatcher
description: Handles Block Kit interactions (Approve/Reject/Edit) for prospector drafts in #prospector-paulina, plus reply-classify buttons. Exposes POST /paulina/post-draft for the composer to render interactive Block Kit drafts.

channel_id.description: Slack channel ID for the prospector channel (default: read from prospector/config.json)

crm_base_url.description: Where the dispatcher posts the parsed action — defaults to the local CRM server.
